programs.description: Discover the beauty of landscape painting in this hands-on acrylic workshop designed for beginners. Learn how to transform a blank canvas into a vibrant natural scene using colour, texture, layering, and composition techniques. Materials list will be provided.    This course is also offered as a four-week intensive.

programs.description: Discover the beauty of landscape painting in this hands-on acrylic workshop designed for beginners. This course is a four-week intensive and is also offered as a full eight-week course.
